HxC Floppy Emulator 2.16.13.1

Author: Jean-Francois Del Nero / HxC2001 and contributors.
Purpose: ZX Spectrum IPF-to-DSK conversion on Windows.
Project: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator
Release: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/releases/tag/HxCFloppyEmulator_V2_16_13_1

Bundled binaries
The x64 hxcfe.exe, x64/x86 libhxcfe.dll and libusbhxcfe.dll, and config.script
are unmodified files from the official Windows archive:
https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/releases/download/HxCFloppyEmulator_V2_16_13_1/HxCFloppyEmulator_soft.zip
Archive SHA-256: e83e361407893dcdab10cc2e169bf0504dfe3802360a902b01269b4585778091

OptiMiyoo rebuilds x86 hxcfe.exe from the unmodified release source, retaining
relocations required by Windows AppContainer. It uses the official x86 DLLs above.
Rebuilt x86 hxcfe.exe SHA-256: 5eb18ce04c9d3d3723bf8177e89d12705bce24e1f17141eb5509c1be4952643e

Source
Revision: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/tree/0a8f492d9b96e7c35283cf4ddf629c802f63fcf1
Included archive: HxCFloppyEmulator-source-2.16.13.1.zip
Download: https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator/archive/0a8f492d9b96e7c35283cf4ddf629c802f63fcf1.zip
Archive SHA-256: ae75804a55635677eaf0754fc772bdeeaa5703acd0b7c2c04149f6a2c193364f

Reproduce the x86 executable
Compiler: official portable Zig 0.17.0.
Download: https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0.zip
Compiler archive SHA-256: b5663f69581dcf391293fbf16c06cb80d81d806545ce618b4d0bab7f0eb8c428

Extract the source to a short path. In cmd.exe, enter its root and set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1743897600
and HXC_RUNTIME to OptiMiyoo's app/ZX/tools/hxc/x86 folder. With zig.exe on PATH,
run this command (shown wrapped; join into one line):

zig cc -target x86-windows-gnu -O2 -s -Wno-error=date-time
  -I libhxcfe/sources -I libusbhxcfe/sources -I libhxcadaptor/sources -I build
  -o hxcfe.exe HxCFloppyEmulator_cmdline/sources/hxcfe.c
  HxCFloppyEmulator_cmdline/sources/utils.c libhxcadaptor/sources/libhxcadaptor.c
  libhxcadaptor/sources/fs.c libhxcadaptor/sources/network.c
  libhxcadaptor/sources/cache.c "%HXC_RUNTIME%/libhxcfe.dll"
  "%HXC_RUNTIME%/libusbhxcfe.dll" -lws2_32 -lwinmm

Licenses
COPYING and COPYING_FULL contain upstream and embedded-library notices.
Compiler/runtime notices are in ../nibtools/COPYING.ZIG and ../nibtools/COPYING.MINGW.
CAPSIMG and its runtime DLLs are documented in ../capsimg and ../runtime.
